Source contracts: scripts/binary_compliance.py

scripts/binary_compliance.py

Python · Tier B

Bind distribution license decisions and SBOMs to staged dependency evidence.

Usage

Called by the native builder after runtime staging and native inspection.

Inputs

Staged package metadata, wheel hashes, native inventory and license policy.

Side effects

Copies license notices and writes dependency reports and CycloneDX SBOMs; release builds fail when required reviews or provenance remain unresolved.

Cleanup

Generated files remain in the caller-owned staging tree for inspection.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py

@see packaging/binary/license-policy.json

distribution_sbom 368 Represent final outer code as well as the embedded runtime, without self-hashing. Compiler runtime redistribution is a separate review from the first-party launcher. Its approval binds to the exact compiler and shipped runtime notices.
